title: ai-accounts: compatibility seam for its T53 interface (F1)
prior_work: Found work F1 (coordinator, 4 Nov), with priority. ai-accounts' T53 rewrite removed names its users still call, with no provider notice. ai-runs (137/145 tests red), ai-use, question-explorer, op-declarations, and answers' limitsUnreadable fixture (and through it wizard-scripts) are red at tranche. Build one compatibility seam here instead of one fix per user. Export accountReferenceSet, accountReferenceState, groupKeySet, groupKeyState, groupKeySwitches, projectKeySet, subscriptionTokenHold, projectSigninSet, and the old accountUsesOf({owner}) and accountFor {key} forms beside the new ones. Implement each over the T53 model, mark each deprecated in a comment, and give each a test under bio-plane/test/m/ai-accounts/ that its old callers' expectation holds (read the callers in bio-plane/src/ai-runs/, ai-use/, question-explorer/, op-declarations/, answers/ and their test worlds, but edit none of them). Keep the T53 interface unchanged. Strike F1 with --test F1=... when every name is in. If some old name has no faithful T53 meaning, block with the name and why, rather than invent behaviour. Do not consolidate the requirements file (82 KB, over the cap): this job starts with --over-cap for the seam alone. Edit no other module, and commit no generated file (rows.mjs, words-unreviewed.json, any dist). Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead.

status.reason: Seam built and pushed (7e42e8f79c); one name has no T53 meaning, and the callers stay red for reasons outside this seam. DONE: bio-plane/src/ai-accounts/legacy.mjs, the last layer, each name deprecated and implemented over the T53 model with R59's meaning of the rows it wrote: accountReferenceSet, accountReferenceState, groupKeySet, groupKeyState, groupKeySwitches, projectKeySet, subscriptionTokenHold, accountUsesOf({owner}) beside R17's {account_id}, and accountFor's old key and kind as non-enumerable fields, so R7's answer is unchanged (serving.test's exact-shape test still passes). test/m/ai-accounts/legacy.test.mjs: 8 tests, each citing the caller line it honours. Notice membership:77 confirmed with no code change (notice-membership-77.test.mjs, 2 tests; PR 77 changed no code, so job complete will need --exempt-revert for it). Suite 104/104. BLOCKED ON: (1) projectSigninSet. R10 says it leaves, R42 says a personal subscription is never a project's account, and K2353 is ended. Under T53 the act can only be refused (PERSONAL_SUBSCRIPTION_LEVEL), but its callers expect ok (ai-use test/m/ai-use/limits.test.mjs:93, question-explorer test/m/question-explorer/choosing.test.mjs:121). I recommend striking it from F1, so those two tests are rewritten in their own jobs. (2) Measured with the seam in place, the callers are still red because their test worlds pass no catalogue to ai-accounts, so every account act fails closed CATALOGUE_UNAVAILABLE (R40, R63). ai-use is 50/90 (was 9). ai-runs is 4/141, 137 of them 'account ...: CATALOGUE_UNAVAILABLE'. question-explorer is 6/46, all 40 'group key: CATALOGUE_UNAVAILABLE'. answers is 66/75, its limitsUnreadable fixture hitting CATALOGUE_UNAVAILABLE. This module cannot fix that without breaking fail-closed. Each caller's world needs ai-catalogue's published fixture passed as catalogue, as test/m/ai-accounts/catalogue.mjs catalogueFor does. That is a world change in each caller's own job. (3) Callers also call removed names that F1 does not list: accountUsesSet({owner}) 30 calls, groupKeySwitch 8, groupKeyNoticeSeen 6, accountUses({owner}) 5, projectKeyNoticeSeen 3, projectAccountSwitch 3, subscriptionConnected 2, accountReferenceRemove 1, projectAccountState 1. op-declarations' 10 failures are the retired ops of R35 ('no aliases'), not in-plane names, so no seam reaches them. TO UNBLOCK: BOB rules (a) projectSigninSet off F1, or kept as T53's refusal; (b) whether F1 widens to the names in (3), and which have a T53 meaning (groupKeyNoticeSeen and projectKeyNoticeSeen map to recipientNoticeSeen, R51; groupKeySwitch and projectAccountSwitch to accountSwitch; accountUsesSet({owner}) to the owner's head account). Then resume this job to finish and complete. The catalogue work in (2) goes to the callers' jobs.
